table.retrieve:
SELECT
	saleledger.saleinvcode, 
	saleledger.date, 
	custcode=dbo.saleledger.custcode,
	patientcode=dbo.saleledger.patientcode,
	saleledger.headerno,
	saleledger.headerinvno,
	saleledger.altersaleinvcode,
	saleledger.custrefno, 
	saleledger.custrefno2, 
	saleledger.custrefno3, 
	saleledger.remarks , 
	accounts.name,
	users.username, 
	posted = saleledger.posted,
	PostedBy = IsNull((Select username from users 
							where dbo.saleledger.postedby = dbo.users.usercode), ''),
	ModifiedBy = IsNull((Select username from users 
							where dbo.saleledger.modifiedby = dbo.users.usercode), ''),
	NetAmount = saleledger.invtotal,
	dbo.saleledger.ReprintingCounter,
	dbo.saleledger.OriginalDate,
	dbo.saleledger.TotalOfSaleReturns,
	dbo.saleledger.ListofSrInvoices,
	dbo.saleledger.ModifyCounter,
	area=(select name from area,customer where area.areacode=customer.areacode and customer.custcode=saleledger.custcode),
	patientregno=(select regno from patient where patient.patientcode=saleledger.patientcode),
	patientname=(select name from patient where patient.patientcode=saleledger.patientcode),
	dbo.saleledger.Deleted,
	StudentCode=dbo.SaleLedger.StudentCode,
	SaleType = (SELECT ST.Name FROM SaleType ST WHERE ST.SaleTypeCode = saleledger.SaleTypeCode),
	SaleTypeInvNo=saleledger.SaleTypeInvNo,
	Fiscalized = saleledger.Fiscalized,
	FiscalizedOn = saleledger.FiscalizedOn,
	FiscalInvoiceNo = saleledger.FiscalInvoiceNo,
	PaidViaAPI = SaleLedger.PaidViaAPI,
	ContactCellNo = (SELECT CC.Mobile FROM ContactCard CC WHERE CC.ContactCardCode = SaleLedger.ContactCardCode),
	sourcemodule = saleledger.moduleid,
	sourcedocument= saleledger.doccode,
	Pushed=SaleLedger.Pushed,
	PushedOn=SaleLedger.PushedOn,
	PushedBy=IsNull((Select username from users 
							where dbo.saleledger.PushedBy = dbo.users.usercode), ''),
	PushedFor = IsNull((SELECT S.Name + ' (' + S.InstanceID + ')' FROM Site S WHERE S.SiteCode=SaleLedger.TargetSiteCode),'')
FROM
	accounts, saleledger, users
WHERE
	( dbo.saleledger.admissioncode IS NULL ) AND 
	( saleledger.custcode = accounts.acccode ) and 
	dbo.saleledger.salecatcode IN (:ai_salecatcode) And
	( dbo.saleledger.salesmancode = dbo.users.usercode)   and
	(dbo.saleledger.date > :ad_invdate) and
	( Posted IN (:as_Posted)) and
	:as_showrows='Y'  AND 
	(dbo.saleledger.headerno IS NULL OR
		(dbo.saleledger.headerno in 
			(SELECT headercode FROM GroupAllowedHeader 
			WHERE GroupCode = :ai_groupcode and module = :ai_module))) AND
	saleledger.impactinventory = 'Y' AND
	Exists (SELECT DBO.Fn_GetPreference('AllowedGroupsInSalesList') 
		WHERE DBO.Fn_GetPreference('AllowedGroupsInSalesList') = 'N')
Union All
SELECT	 
	saleledger.saleinvcode , 
	saleledger.date , 
	custcode=dbo.saleledger.custcode,
	patientcode=dbo.saleledger.patientcode,
	saleledger.headerno,
	saleledger.headerinvno,
	saleledger.altersaleinvcode,
	saleledger.custrefno, 
	saleledger.custrefno2, 
	saleledger.custrefno3, 
	saleledger.remarks , 
	accounts.name,
	users.username, 
	posted = saleledger.posted,
	PostedBy = IsNull((Select username from users 
							where dbo.saleledger.postedby = dbo.users.usercode), ''),
	ModifiedBy = IsNull((Select username from users 
							where dbo.saleledger.modifiedby = dbo.users.usercode), ''),
	NetAmount = saleledger.invtotal,
	dbo.saleledger.ReprintingCounter,
	dbo.saleledger.OriginalDate,
	dbo.saleledger.TotalOfSaleReturns,
	dbo.saleledger.ListofSrInvoices,
	dbo.saleledger.ModifyCounter,
	area=(select name from area,customer where area.areacode=customer.areacode and customer.custcode=saleledger.custcode),
	patientregno=(select regno from patient where patient.patientcode=saleledger.patientcode),
	patientname=(select name from patient where patient.patientcode=saleledger.patientcode),
	dbo.saleledger.Deleted,
	StudentCode=dbo.SaleLedger.StudentCode,
	SaleType = (SELECT ST.Name FROM SaleType ST WHERE ST.SaleTypeCode = saleledger.SaleTypeCode),
	SaleTypeInvNo=saleledger.SaleTypeInvNo,
	Fiscalized = saleledger.Fiscalized,
	FiscalizedOn = saleledger.FiscalizedOn,
	FiscalInvoiceNo = saleledger.FiscalInvoiceNo,
	PaidViaAPI = SaleLedger.PaidViaAPI,
	ContactCellNo = (SELECT CC.Mobile FROM ContactCard CC WHERE CC.ContactCardCode = SaleLedger.ContactCardCode),
	sourcemodule = saleledger.moduleid,
	sourcedocument = saleledger.doccode,
	Pushed=SaleLedger.Pushed,
	PushedOn=SaleLedger.PushedOn,
	PushedBy=IsNull((Select username from users 
							where dbo.saleledger.PushedBy = dbo.users.usercode), ''),
	PushedFor = IsNull((SELECT S.Name + ' (' + S.InstanceID + ')' FROM Site S WHERE S.SiteCode=SaleLedger.TargetSiteCode),'')
FROM  
	accounts, saleledger, users
WHERE
	( dbo.saleledger.admissioncode IS NULL ) AND 
	( saleledger.custcode = accounts.acccode ) and 
	dbo.saleledger.salecatcode IN (:ai_salecatcode) And
	( dbo.saleledger.salesmancode = dbo.users.usercode)   and
	(dbo.saleledger.date > :ad_invdate) and
	( Posted IN (:as_Posted)) and
	:as_showrows='Y'  AND 
	(dbo.saleledger.headerno IS NULL OR
		(dbo.saleledger.headerno in 
			(SELECT headercode FROM GroupAllowedHeader 
			WHERE GroupCode = :ai_groupcode and module = :ai_module))) AND
	saleledger.impactinventory = 'Y' AND
	saleledger.salesmancode IN (
								Select 	Distinct U.usercode
								From   	Users U, UserGroups UG, GroupAllowedGroups GAG
								Where  	U.UserCode = UG.UserCode And UG.GroupCode = GAG.AllowedGroupCode And 
											GAG.GroupCode = :ai_groupcode And GAG.Module = :ai_module
								Union 
								Select   U.Usercode
								From     Users U, UserGroups UG
								Where    U.usercode = UG.usercode And UG.GroupCode = :ai_groupcode
								
							  ) And
	Exists (SELECT DBO.Fn_GetPreference('AllowedGroupsInSalesList') 
		WHERE DBO.Fn_GetPreference('AllowedGroupsInSalesList') = 'Y')
order by 
	saleledger.saleinvcode
